_comment: Few-shot examples for DSP and shader generation. Each entry has a 'vibe' (the natural language description) and an 'output' (the expected LLM response demonstrating correct format). PromptBuilder injects up to 2 examples per request to guide output structure without exceeding token budget.

dsp.vibe: A warm, intimate reverb — like playing guitar alone in a small wooden cabin at night
Gritty tape-saturated overdrive — the sound of a cassette recorder being pushed too hard
Slow shimmering tremolo — a candle flame flickering in a quiet room

shader.vibe: Frosted glass distortion with cyberpunk chromatic aberration — looking through a scratched plexiglass panel at neon lights
Warm vintage film grain with soft vignette — an old Super 8 home movie from the 1970s
Glitchy RGB pixel sort with horizontal scanline tears — a corrupted broadcast signal
